   * Select a message which is currently new and unread, and wait for the message
   * being fully loaded, the folder status updates and the UI updates.

   * @param {object} info
   * @param {integer} info.rowIndex - index of the row in the tree to be selected

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The thread test passes rowIndex and messageIndex in one object, documenting the UI row versus the sourceMessageIDs entry. Recommend these explicit role names in this family where collapsed threads change the mapping. The checked helper uses each value for a different action; an unqualified index obscures that contract. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Name thread row and source-message indices by their different roles
